description: On March 10th, I joined Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham as she signed the Childcare Assistance Program Act into law. I was proud to be a sponsor on this legislation that funds universal childcare in our state. Our children deserve high quality education and care and parents should be about to access
title: Governor Signs SB 241 - Funding First of its Kind Universal Childcare Program — Doreen Ybarra Gallegos - NM State Representative District 52
